generator.params.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 330-331), Zamia pumila: stem subterranean and tuberous, 25 to 30 cm long, 8 to 10 cm across; leaves four to eight; mature 3 to 5 years from seed. Drawn as a trunk 0.045 m in radius, staying underground; 2 fronds a year, as the crown's count over the three years a frond lives (estimated); first cones at 4 years (estimated, as the research note's timing table records). Female cone solitary on a peduncle 2.5 to 4 cm, male cones one to several on peduncles 1 to 2 cm. The leaves' sizes, leaflets and posture come from its traits.

allometry.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 330-331), Zamia pumila: stem subterranean and tuberous, 25 to 30 cm long, 8 to 10 cm across; leaves four to eight, 0.9 to 1.5 m long, the petiole 20 to 40 cm; leaflets in 25 to 31 pairs, 20 to 25 cm by 1.3 to 2 cm; mature 3 to 5 years from seed. The whole plant's height at 30 years estimated from these, its stem (or none, where it stays underground) under a crown of young leaves standing about 0.85 of a leaf above it: about 1 m. Whitelock gives no ages, so the tolerance is wide.

taxon.note: Scientific and common names as the spec's authors wrote them (the scientific name where no common name is in wide use), and the genus the scientific name is written in.

growth_form.note: The growth form the spec's authors chose from the plant's habit: a cycad's crown of pinnate leaves on a pachycaul stem, drawn on the palm program.

growth.note: The growth plan (years, step, keyframes) chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

variants.note: The environments and seeds chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact: four seeds, so male and female plants both show.

taxon.family.note: WCVP v16's family for the accepted name.

taxon.plant_name_id.note: WCVP v16's plant_name_id for the accepted species the name resolves to (the accepted name).

traits.leaf_length_m.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 330-331), Zamia pumila: leaves usually four to eight, erect, 0.9 to 1.5 m long with the petiole of 20 to 40 cm, 30 to 50 cm wide, flat or slightly keeled: the blade, without its petiole, 0.5 to 1.3 m (the shortest leaf less the longest petiole to the longest less the shortest).

traits.petiole_length_m.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 330-331), Zamia pumila: petiole slightly flattened above, brownish green, 20 to 40 cm long, 5 to 7 mm across, unarmed.

traits.leaflets.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 330-331), Zamia pumila: leaflets in 25 to 31 pairs, moderately spaced.

traits.leaflet_length_m.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 330-331), Zamia pumila: median leaflets 20 to 25 cm long, straight or slightly falcate.

traits.leaflet_width_m.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 330-331), Zamia pumila: median leaflets 1.3 to 2 cm wide, flexible, the margin slightly revolute, with a few small teeth in the apical third.

traits.leaf_posture.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 330-331), Zamia pumila: leaves erect.

traits.leaf_colour.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 330-331), Zamia pumila: leaves dark green; the colour by eye.

traits.cone_face_height_m.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 330-331), Zamia pumila: the megasporophyll's face 1.2 to 1.5 cm high by 2.8 to 3.2 cm wide, the facets indistinct.

traits.pollen_cone_face_height_m.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 330-331), Zamia pumila: the microsporophyll's face 4 to 5 mm high by 1.2 to 1.7 cm wide, the facets indistinct.

traits.cone_length_m.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 330-331), Zamia pumila: female cones solitary, 10 to 15 cm long, apiculate with a tip of reduced sporophylls.

traits.cone_width_m.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 330-331), Zamia pumila: female cone 6 to 8 cm across.

traits.cone_face_width_m.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 330), Zamia pumila: the megasporophyll's face 1.2 to 1.5 by 2.8 to 3.2 cm, its facets indistinct.

traits.cone_shape.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 330-331), Zamia pumila: female cone ovoid; by eye from photographs, as the research note records.

traits.cone_apex.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 330-331), Zamia pumila: female cone apiculate, with a tip of reduced sporophylls.

traits.cone_colour.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 330-331), Zamia pumila: female cone red-brown to maroon felted; the colour by eye.

traits.pollen_cone_length_m.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 330-331), Zamia pumila: male cones long conical, 8 to 13 cm long.

traits.pollen_cone_width_m.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 330-331), Zamia pumila: male cone 2 to 2.4 cm across.

traits.pollen_cone_face_width_m.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 330), Zamia pumila: the microsporophyll's face 0.4 to 0.5 by 1.2 to 1.7 cm.

traits.pollen_cone_shape.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 330-331), Zamia pumila: male cones long conical.

traits.pollen_cone_apex.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 330-331), Zamia pumila: male cone's apex blunt, of reduced sporophylls.

traits.pollen_cone_colour.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 330-331), Zamia pumila: male cone red-brown to light brown felted; the colour by eye.

traits.seed_length_m.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 330-331), Zamia pumila: sclerotesta irregularly globose, three-sided, 16 to 20 mm long.

traits.seed_width_m.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 330-331), Zamia pumila: sclerotesta 14 to 16 mm across.

traits.seed_colour_ripe.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 330-331), Zamia pumila: sarcotesta red when ripe; the colour by eye.

traits.sexual_system.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 330-331), Zamia pumila: male and female cones on separate plants, as in every cycad (p. 19).
